name_reason: Two defects in current name. (1) 'angle_step' is semantically wrong: this double is the y-amplitude scale applied to the sin term in y[i] = angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0, NOT an angle increment. The real per-slot angle step is the inline float 0x3C8EFA2D (= pi/180, held in var_24 at 0x26E4E); disasm proves [0x5022B] is consumed at 0x27033 via FMUL after the sin product (FMULP at 0x27031), i.e. it scales vertical magnitude. (2) '_12' is a value-derived suffix encoding the literal value 1.2 (decimal point dropped), not a domain ID (not a chapter/item/spell/job/portrait id), not an array dimension, not a multiplier count -- naming rules require role/type-reflecting names, not value-in-name. Proposed name keeps domain (animation) + specific animation (summon radial) + role (y-amplitude scale), no value residue, no Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Summon-spell variant-C 5-slot radial animation y-amplitude scale: the constant 1.2 multiplier on the sin term that stretches the vertical extent of each radial-ring slot's y-coordinate.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial (@ 0x26E39) consumes it at 0x27033 via FMUL double ptr [0x5022B] while computing each of the 5 ring slots' y position: y[i] = (int)( angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0 ). The 1.2 (this symbol @ 0x5022B) is the y-amplitude scale; the +30.0 y-offset is the sibling double @ 0x50233 (FADD at 0x27039). The x-coordinate uses cos with the same angle_accumulator and a team-dependent x base. angle_rad = (float)(i*0x48) * (pi/180) where the pi/180 angle step is the inline literal 0x3C8EFA2D, distinct from this constant.
element_semantics: Scalar constant 1.2 -- y-amplitude scale multiplier on the per-slot sin term of the radial-ring y-coordinate.
notes: Single READ xref (0x27033) from fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial, no writers -> const confirmed (game-side has zero write-xref). Memory bytes verified = 1.2. src comment (anitab.c lines 9-23) already correctly describes role as 'y-amplitude scale', cites FMUL @ 0x27033, sibling 30.0 @ 0x50233, exact bytes, read-only -> comment kept unchanged (no src Edit). Ghidra data plate was blank (null) -> created concise plate via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT with the role description + NOTE distinguishing it from the angle step. The misleading 'angle_step'/'_12' wording lives only in the symbol NAME (header echo in src + symbol); Stage 2 rename will propagate the new name everywhere (protos.h/globals.h/call sites). This stage records the proposal only, no rename applied.
